keystroke_to_suggestions_ms.method: scripts/search-timing.mjs: t0 = input event, t1 = first animation frame after the suggestion rows changed; 6 queries, server warmed, fresh context per query; median
keystroke_to_suggestions_ms.note: 200 ms debounce + one /api/search round trip per keystroke; locally the database (Supabase, remote) dominates and varies 80 ms – 2.7 s

api_search_server_ms.method: scripts/search-api-timing.mjs: 9 queries x 3 rounds; Server-Timing total/db from the route; round 1 cold, rounds 2-3 warm (median)

production.note: repeat queries return the same db;dur: an Nginx proxy cache answers them (Cache-Control s-maxage=300); the live build has no total;dur yet

lighthouse_mobile.method: scripts/lighthouse-perf.mjs: Lighthouse 13.5.0 default mobile emulation, 3 runs, median run kept in docs/search/lighthouse/before-*.json; local server
lighthouse_mobile.inp_note: lab Lighthouse has no INP; the longest input event while typing (Event Timing API) is in keystroke_to_suggestions_ms
